title: Fix Go Relative Dates Complete
prompt: Complete the refactoring for relative dates in the Go CLI. Implement a flexible time parser that handles both RFC3339 and YYYY-MM-DD formats. Update template functions and tree rendering logic to use this parser for consistent relative dates across goals and tickets.
